meta.title: Messaging & App Channels
meta.grain: one row per country x communication app
meta.why: Referral stats (StatCounter) structurally cannot see messaging apps. Measured here: WhatsApp (Messenger or Business) is the top messaging app in 72 countries, Telegram in 38 — neither appears in referral share at all.
meta.ios_caveat: iOS ONLY. Most of these countries are Android-majority and Google publishes no keyless equivalent, so this is one eye open. An app absent here is NOT absent in-country. 50 of 175 countries have no Apple storefront.
meta.ranking_caveat: A top-free RANK is most-DOWNLOADED recently, not most-used.
meta.classification_caveat: kind is a name-keyword HEURISTIC over a known list, not a verified taxonomy.

source.name: Apple App Store RSS — top free apps by country
source.licence: public Apple marketing feed, no key
source.measures: most-downloaded free apps in a country storefront, right now
source.does_not_measure: Android (no keyless equivalent), actual usage, anything per-city
source.why: StatCounter tracks only Western referral platforms and cannot see WhatsApp/WeChat/Telegram/TikTok/LINE/Viber/imo/Zalo — the channels that dominate most of this corpus
